name: Városközpont

definitionSource.title: Mezőberény antiszegregációs terv, 2010. május
definitionSource.role: Explicit ordered street circuit defining the complete Városközpont district, transcribed below as factual road identifiers.

contextSource.title: Mezőberény Integrált Településfejlesztési Stratégia – megalapozó tanulmány, 2021. február
facts: The study reassesses and retains the previous seven-part subdivision.

The central district includes residential blocks, Luther tér, Kismester and Nagymester streets and the Kölcsey estate context, rather than just the municipal office building or a commercial zoning parcel.
The complete district and the narrower town-center building zone are different concepts.

sourceSidesQualification: The planning text explicitly includes both sides of the Puskin segment up to Madách. This reconstruction follows street centerlines and does not claim cadastral parcel-side precision.
